archetype: Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) paired with Neo-Brutalist (Swiss) styling for a product-like lab feel
reasoning: The 'Content Lab' concept demands an experimental and playful yet highly structured aesthetic. A stark white background with hard black borders establishes the 'lab console' identity, while pastel sticker elements, bold typography, and draggable components provide the 'creative workshop' feel.

classes.h1: font-heading text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-black
classes.h2: font-heading text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-black

layout_and_spacing.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections to give breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_shadows: Neo-brutalist style: Use border-2 border-black. For shadows on cards/buttons, use shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)].

navigation.description: Sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, z-50, border-b-2 border-black). Must include 'Content Lab' logo, 3-5 branded module links ('01. LAB', '02. PROOF') in IBM Plex Mono, and a Neo-brutalist CTA.

hero.description: Product-like Lab Console. 3-liner massive paragraph (Cabinet Grotesk) describing Abhinav Sharma's unique universe. Include multiple absolute-positioned draggable 'stickers' (e.g., pill shapes with pastel backgrounds and black borders) using Framer Motion.

heres_how.description: Grid layout acting as a methodology board. Use SVG shapes/dummy art connected by moving arrows (Framer Motion strokeDasharray animations) illustrating a system.

case_studies.description: Three case study cards (Proof Board). White bg, black borders, hard black shadow. Images on top, clean mono typography below. Hover interaction: press down (translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px] and shadow reduced to 2px).

experiment_shelf.description: Masonry layout (CSS columns-2 md:columns-4 gap-4) containing 12 vertical video reels. Overlay a text block in the center saying 'I experiment a lot'. Clicking any video opens a Shadcn Dialog containing the video title, description, and an embedded player (or styled placeholder).

process.description: A journey line winding from top-left to bottom-right across the section. Use an SVG path animated with framer-motion on scroll. Add hand-drawn spiral SVGs at key vertices, labeling each as a process step.

footer.description: Three-column grid. Center: Abstract SVGs for 'dummy art'. Left: 'My Philosophy' typography block. Right: Hand-drawn links for LinkedIn and Email using Caveat font and wavy SVG underlines.

motion_and_interactions.draggable: Enable framer-motion 'drag' for stickers in the Hero section so users can play with them.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: All cards and buttons must use a 'press' effect rather than a 'lift' effect, matching the tactile lab aesthetic.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_svg: Use framer-motion useScroll to dynamically draw the process section's line.
motion_and_interactions.data_testid: Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, dialog triggers) have a valid data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do not use placeholder images. Loop over the provided video_reels array to generate 12 total items (duplicate them to reach 12).
CRITICAL: Add @import url('https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@800,500,700,400,900&display=swap'); to your index.css to load the Cabinet Grotesk font.
CRITICAL: Ensure you create .js or .jsx files, NOT .tsx files.
Install 'framer-motion' for all drag and scroll animations.
Configure Tailwind with theme extensions for 'Cabinet Grotesk', 'IBM Plex Mono', and 'Caveat' (use Google Fonts for the latter two).
For the experiment shelf, use CSS columns (columns-2 md:columns-4) instead of flex/grid to get an authentic masonry layout easily.
The footer dummy art should be implemented using native SVG shapes or lucide-react icons, arranged creatively, rather than using generic image URLs.
Use Shadcn Dialog component for the video popup functionality.
Ensure the entire app feels like an interactive tool rather than just a static page. Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements.
